title: Hydroxysafflor yellow A mitigates lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury by enhancing pulmonary microvascular endothelial barrier function via Calpain-1/HIF-1alpha inhibition.
authors: Liu, Tao; Huang, Yihao; Li, Yuan; Li, Xinqiu; Su, Zixuan; Wang, Yiheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HSYA通过抑制Calpain-1/HIF-1alpha通路保护肺微血管内皮屏障，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Pulmonary microvascular endothelial cell (PMEC) barrier dysfunction is a critical pathological hallmark of acute lung injury (ALI). Hydroxysafflor yellow A (HSYA), a major active component of safflower, exhibits potential protective effects against lung injury. The current study aimed to investigate whether HSYA preserves PMEC barrier integrity in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced ALI by inhibiting the Calpain-1/hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) pathway. METHODS: In vivo, mice with LPS-induced ALI were pretreated with HSYA or a Calpain-1 overexpression lentivirus. In vitro, LPS-stimulated PMECs were treated with HSYA, Calpain-1 siRNA, or HIF-1alpha overexpression plasmids. Lung injury, cellular apoptosis, endothelial barrier integrity, and related molecular expressions were assessed using histological staining, wet/dry ratio, flow cytometry, transendothelial electrical resistance (TEER), ELISA, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence. Furthermore, direct HSYA-protein interactions were analyzed via molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance (SPR). RESULTS: HSYA significantly ameliorated LPS-induced lung damage, inflammatory responses, oxidative stress, and pulmonary microvascular endothelial barrier dysfunction in vivo, while reducing apoptosis and restoring barrier integrity in PMECs in vitro. Mechanistically, molecular docking and SPR analyses confirmed that HSYA directly binds to Calpain-1 with high affinity, thereby inhibiting its activity and subsequently downregulating HIF-1alpha expression. Furthermore, silencing Calpain-1 provided the protective effects against LPS-induced PMEC injury, whereas HIF-1alpha overexpression partially abolished these benefits. Moreover, Calpain-1 overexpression partly reversed the protective effects of HSYA on PMEC barrier dysfunction and ALI in mice. CONCLUSIONS: HSYA mitigates LPS-induced ALI by preserving pulmonary microvascular barrier function via direct inhibition of the Calpain-1/HIF-1alpha pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：肺微血管内皮细胞（PMEC）屏障功能障碍是急性肺损伤（ALI）的关键病理标志。羟基红花黄色素A（HSYA）是红花的主要活性成分，对肺损伤具有潜在的保护作用。本研究旨在探讨HSYA是否通过抑制Calpain-1/缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1alpha）通路，在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI中维持PMEC屏障完整性。方法：在体内实验中，对LPS诱导的ALI小鼠预先给予HSYA或Calpain-1过表达慢病毒处理。在体外实验中，对LPS刺激的PMECs分别给予HSYA、Calpain-1 siRNA或HIF-1alpha过表达质粒处理。通过组织学染色、湿/干比、流式细胞术、跨内皮细胞电阻（TEER）、ELISA、RT-qPCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光评估肺损伤、细胞凋亡、内皮屏障完整性及相关分子表达。此外，通过分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）分析HSYA与蛋白质的直接相互作用。结果：HSYA在体内显著改善LPS诱导的肺损伤、炎症反应、氧化应激和肺微血管内皮屏障功能障碍，同时在体外减少PMECs凋亡并恢复屏障完整性。机制上，分子对接和SPR分析证实HSYA以高亲和力直接结合Calpain-1，从而抑制其活性，并随后下调HIF-1alpha表达。此外，沉默Calpain-1对LPS诱导的PMEC损伤提供保护作用，而HIF-1alpha过表达部分抵消了这些益处。同时，Calpain-1过表达部分逆转了HSYA对PMEC屏障功能障碍和ALI小鼠的保护作用。结论：HSYA通过直接抑制Calpain-1/HIF-1alpha通路，维持肺微血管屏障功能，从而减轻LPS诱导的ALI。
